info.title: Paperwork.CLI
info.description: Paperwork CLI — generate PDFs from the command line using the Paperwork / Scryber engine.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Paperwork — generate dynamic PDF reports from the command line.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --template
options.description: Paperwork template ID to fetch from Firebase Storage.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Firebase environment: production (default), staging, or dev.

options.name: --personal
options.description: Fetch one of your own personal-scope templates (--template must be the full '{owner}:{slug}' id). Requires 'paperwork login' first.

options.name: --collection
options.description: Fetch a template published in a collection - the collection's id, e.g. 'acme:reports' (--template is the template's id within it). Requires 'paperwork login' first, as a member of the collection.

options.name: --portal
options.description: The portal whose configuration (endpoints, allowed domains) to generate with, e.g. 'paperwork.design'. Defaults to the environment's main portal.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to a TemplateConfigV1 JSON file.

options.name: --layout
options.description: Path to an HTML layout file.

options.name: --style
options.description: CSS file to include. Repeat for multiple files.

options.name: --data
options.description: Data binding in the form name=path.json. Repeat for multiple sources.

options.name: --field
options.description: Field override in the form key=value. Repeat for multiple values.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output PDF path. Omit to write PDF bytes to stdout.

options.name: --sync
options.description: Render synchronously. Remote content (stored assets, map images, remote template sources) is not waited for, so it will be missing - only for documents that use none.

options.name: --async
options.description: No longer needed - generation is asynchronous by default. Accepted and ignored.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a TemplateConfigV1 JSON config file.

arguments.name: CONFIG
arguments.description: Path to the TemplateConfigV1 JSON file to validate.

options.name: --personal
options.description: Your own personal-scope templates. Requires 'paperwork login' first.

options.name: --public
options.description: Templates in the public library published by one owner. Requires --owner.

options.name: --owner
options.description: With --public: the owner's user id - the part of a template id before the colon, e.g. 'j-smith'.

options.name: --private
options.description: Templates published in a collection. Requires --collection, and 'paperwork login' as a member of it.

options.name: --collection
options.description: With --private: the collection's id, e.g. 'acme:reports'.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Firebase environment: production (default), staging, or dev.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the list as JSON, for use in scripts.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Sign in, for your personal templates and the collections you belong to.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Sign-in provider: github (default). microsoft and google are not yet supported.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Firebase environment: production (default), staging, or dev.

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Sign out - forget the saved sign-in on this machine.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Firebase environment to sign out of: production (default), staging, or dev.

options.name: --all
options.description: Sign out of every environment.

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Show who you are signed in as, and check the sign-in still works.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Check one environment only: production, staging, or dev. Omit to check every saved sign-in.
